verdict.rationale: Figma ships strong first-party dev-handoff tooling: Code Connect maps design system components directly to real production code snippets in Dev Mode (figma-gh-1, figma-gh-2, figma-docs-60), and the MCP server can generate code from selected frames, extract variables/component context, and even build into production (figma-docs-2, figma-docs-39, figma-docs-25, figma-docs-35). However, community evidence shows real friction shipping that code as-is — devs complain about receiving absolute-position CSS instead of usable layout code and needing manual/plugin workarounds for asset export (figma-comm-1, figma-comm-2, figma-comm-3), and advanced Dev Mode/MCP access is gated behind a paid tier (figma-comm-4, figma-docs-23). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that MCP/Code-Connect output is shippable without manual cleanup at scale, and confirmation that core code-mapping isn't paywalled behind Dev Mode license.
